title: Cloud Wrapper
description: Unified multicloud wrapper for AWS, Azure, and GCP

CORE_RETAIN_IP.description: Flag: --retain-ip. Preserve the Public IP when deprovisioning a node.

CORE_RETAIN_DATA.description: Flag: --retain-data. Preserve the data volumes when deprovisioning a node.

CORE_KEEP_LAST.description: Flag: --keep-last <N>. Number of backups to retain per node.

CORE_FROM_BACKUP.description: Flag: --from-backup <ID>. The ID of the backup or snapshot to restore from.
